routes.scope: Original Medicare Part B claims processed by CGS (J15 A/B MAC) for Kentucky services; not Medicare Advantage
routes.time_limit: Within 12 months of the original claim remittance date (CGS). CMS rule: 1 year from the initial determination for any reason, up to 4 years with good cause.

channels.name: myCGS Reopenings form, opened from the Claims tab
fields: Open from the Claims tab so provider, beneficiary and claim sections fill in
Claim ICN (from the CGS remittance advice)

Type (Billed Amount, Cancel Entire Claim, Cancel Line, Date of Service, Header Diagnosis Codes, Line Diagnosis Pointer, Modifier, MSP, MSP Reprocess Primary, Non-MSP Other Situations, Place of Service, Procedure Codes, Rendering NPI, Reprocess Claim, Units)
ADD (repeat for each change on the same ICN)
Reason for Request and PDF attachments (Other Situations types only)
attachments: PDF only, up to 10 files, 40 MB each, 150 MB total (MSP and Non-MSP Other Situations types)
channels.notes: CGS calls this the best route; automated types adjust without manual handling. One claim per form. If the change lowers payment, use an Overpayment Recovery request instead. Cancel line, header diagnosis and line diagnosis pointer changes exist only in myCGS. Take the ICN and line order from the RA in myCGS, not a clearinghouse copy.

channels.name: CGS Part B IVR, main menu option 6: Telephone Reopenings (TRO)
fields: Patient last name, first 6 letters, then #
Action: 1 modifier add/remove/replace, 2 diagnosis add/remove/replace, 3 replace date of service
New value (IVR gives a reference number)
channels.notes: Only modifier, diagnosis and date of service (month and day; the year cannot be changed) corrections. A claim already adjusted, appealed or needing documentation cannot go through the IVR. IVR hours for options 1 to 4 and 6: Monday to Friday 6 a.m. to 9 p.m. ET, Saturday 6 a.m. to 6 p.m. ET.

channels.name: Written reopening on the CGS hardcopy form for the correction type (GRF 679 when no specific form fits)
channels.where: J15 – Part B Correspondence CGS Administrators, LLC Attn: Reopenings PO Box 20018 Nashville, TN 37202
channels.form: GRF 679 Medicare Part B Reopenings Adjustment Request Form
fields: Last 5 digits of Tax ID Number
Adjustment Details: MSP, Non-MSP, or cancel this claim
attachments: Have the claim's remittance advice at hand: the form asks for its details
channels.notes: Manual processing, up to 60 days. Type the form. The GRF 679 footer prints J15 - Part B Correspondence, CGS, PO Box 20018, Nashville, TN 37202. CGS has a form for each correction type: BPC 346 (billed amount, procedure codes), DOS 568 (date of service), RMF 780 (modifier), POS 419 (place of service), RNP 237 (rendering NPI), UBA 817 (units), REP 913 (reprocess claim), GRF 679 (cancel a claim, MSP and other situations).

channels.name: Fax (written reopening by fax)
channels.notes: CGS says reopening requests may not be filed by fax.

channels.name: Telephone reopening with a customer service representative
channels.notes: The CGS Part B telephone reopening line stopped taking corrections on August 1, 2026. The IVR, myCGS and written requests remain.

routes.scope: Original Medicare Part B claims processed by CGS (J15 A/B MAC) for Kentucky services; not Medicare Advantage
routes.time_limit: 120 days from the date of receipt of the notice of initial determination (presumed received 5 days after the notice date). CGS has 60 days to decide.

channels.name: myCGS Redetermination form (Request Redetermination button on the claim's Detailed Claim Status Information page)
fields: Claims tab: find the finalized claim and open Claim #
Reason for the redetermination (up to 1200 characters)
Submit and confirm the e-signature box
attachments: Visit note or medical records for the date of service
Signed ABN when appealing a GA modifier line
channels.notes: Preferred by CGS. Up to 10 PDFs, 40 MB each, 150 MB total. A Submission ID comes back for status tracking.

channels.name: Medicare Part B Jurisdiction 15 Redetermination Request Form (CMS-20027 also accepted)
channels.where: CGS Attn: J15 Part B Appeals Department PO Box 20018 Nashville, TN 37202
channels.form: Medicare Part B Jurisdiction 15 Redetermination Request Form
fields: Overpayment Appeal (MR PROBE, UPIC, CERT, RAC, Other)
Initial ICN (overpayment ICN if an overpayment)
channels.notes: Type the form and put it on top of the packet. Do not send a duplicate while one is pending.

channels.name: Fax
channels.notes: CGS says redetermination requests may not be filed by fax.

routes.scope: Second-level appeals of CGS Part B redeterminations for Kentucky services (QIC Part B North, C2C Innovative Solutions)
routes.time_limit: 180 days from the date of receipt of the redetermination (60 days to ask the QIC to review a redetermination dismissal).

channels.name: C2C QIC Part B North Appeals Portal
channels.form: CMS-20033 (fillable) or CGS Medicare Part B Reconsideration Form
fields: Sign up or sign in at the C2C appellant portal
Select the appeal jurisdiction (QIC Part B North)
Upload one PDF holding the reconsideration request form and all the documentation
Optional: an Excel list of the claims (claim number, Medicare number, date of service, procedure code)
attachments: Records not already sent to CGS
